name: PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk
summary: PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk engages in the mining activities in Indonesia. It explores for gold, silver, copper, nickel, and other related minerals. The company holds 100% interest in its flagship Tujuh Bukit copper project. It is also involved in metal manufacturing and trading services business; mining and construction services business; own and lease real estate business; business consulting and business broker services business, as well as consulting management activities. The company was formerly known as PT Merdeka Sera and changed its name to PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk in December 2014. PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk was founded in 2012 and is headquartered in Jakarta, Indonesia.
